frequency_question: What proportion of bilateral technical treaty renewals requiring joint data assessment and legal drafting are completed within a 132-day execution window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal intergovernmental water-sharing or shared river basin treaty renewal, extension, or protocol renegotiation involving two sovereign states with pre-existing framework agreements. Excludes brand-new treaty negotiations from scratch.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime adjustments
India-Pakistan Indus Waters Commission annual work plan renewals
Senegal River Basin Development Organisation (OMVS) protocol renewals
Israel-Jordan water quota protocol renewals under the 1994 Peace Treaty
Mexico-United States 1944 Water Treaty minute negotiations (e.g., Minute 319 and 323)
Lesotho Highlands Water Project phase protocol extensions

coverage_note: 7 named cases covering major international river basin management renewals.
known_gaps: Excludes minor administrative amendments that did not require formal diplomatic protocol signatures.
skeleton: Bilateral technical renewals categorized by tight deadlines (<6 months) versus extended negotiations (>1 year).
multiplier: 7 total identified comparable treaty renewal cycles with short execution windows.
validity_reason: Bilateral treaty negotiation protocols and bureaucratic drafting speeds remain stable over multi-year horizons unless major international legal frameworks are overhauled.
